description: This is a system generated manifest of files expected to be present in this zip. It can be safely deleted.

manifest.description: This is the data you will use for training.
This contains IDs for Phase 1 and 2 and test data for Phase 1.

This shows the submission format for this challenge, with each ID having 4 generations. You must keep the column names the same. The order of the rows does not matter, but the names of the IDs must be correct.
This is ground truth for Phase 1 to help you learn about the problem and put together an initial solution.
